data.case_title: Refund interest (Erstattungszinsen) for income tax 2023 – Finanzamt Beispielsoest
data.title: Notice of refund interest (Bescheid über Erstattungszinsen) for income tax 2023
data.summary: Finanzamt Beispielsoest notifies Bastian Musterquell that it will pay €42.00 in refund interest (Erstattungszinsen) under § 233a AO for 28 full months, related to the amended 2023 income tax assessment; the amount will be transferred together with the refund.
data.explanation: This letter is a formal decision (Bescheid) about interest the tax office owes you on a tax refund, not a bill. The €42.00 will be paid automatically with your refund, so you don't need to do anything for that. The letter does open a right to object (Einspruch) if you disagree with the interest calculation; the app will show you the deadline for that. Note that this interest counts as investment income (Einkünfte aus Kapitalvermögen) for a future tax return. A separate certificate for that will follow.

key_facts.quote:

42,00 € für 28 volle Monate (§ 233a AO).
